title: After losing both grandparents, 17-year-old Hudson Waters recreated their home in a backyard shed
summary_full: Hudson Waters created a heartfelt replica of his grandparents' home in a backyard shed. He carefully filled the space with their furniture and cherished belongings. This personal project helped him cope with profound grief after their passing. The touching tribute has since resonated with thousands of people online. His story highlights the importance of preserving familiar spaces and family history.
